semantic_licenses.basis: Each spoke has the repeated visible le + numeral-like sequence + iorn + de + different terminal word. The words iorn/de and month-like endings jointly support day-of-month phrases, rather than merely assuming dates from the wheel topology.
semantic_licenses.source_relation: Four inscriptions are boundary dates between seasonal figure sectors. The graphic bars delimit intervals; they do not appear to be four intrinsic qualities each owned exclusively by one personification. A boundary can end one interval and begin the next.
